title: Reminded of a shared dream experience from a few years back
content: So basically I’m just thinking about this time a few years ago when I was in school and I was hanging out with some friends outside. I was with one friend and we were talking and I just had this weird feeling to bring up the dream I had the night prior. The dream I’d had was pretty much that the school had been set on fire and everyone had to leave. Right at that moment my friend gets a shocked look on his face and starts laughing at me whilst telling me that he also had a dream the night before about the school being on fire. I then described what part of the school I was in and he mentioned that he was in a different part of the school in his dream. It just kinda got me thinking about the idea that we could sometimes actually be in dreams with other people, as weird as it sounds. What if dreams aren’t just creations of the mind, as much as they are different plains of existence that can be crossed into by people living similar experiences. It was my closest friend who I shared this experience with so maybe that has something to do with it, as if being close to someone could increase the chances you cross into the same dream reality. Now I know this all probably bullshit and it was most likely just a coincidence, but I just found it something interesting to think about. I also deal with a lot of sleep paralysis related issues, and often have to deal with visual and physical hallucinations. Just last night I had a bad episode of sleep paralysis and was being violently thrown around and attacked by something behind me. I don’t really believe that these hallucinations are anymore than illusions of the mind, but they fool the senses so well they might as well be real, and I do find it odd that all hallucinations I have related to sleep are always incredibly negative and terrifying. It’s as if the very basis of what makes you hallucinate during sleep paralysis is fear.
